concerns.text: "System MUST execute permutation tests (≥1,000 iterations) to validate the statistical significance of enrichment findings (See US-3)." This requirement conflicts with the Assumption that the entire pipeline can complete within 6 hours on a CPU‑only environment.

"System MUST include a sensitivity analysis for the "rewiring" threshold (sweeping the edge weight difference cutoff over the set {0.01, 0.05, 0.1})..." Combined with the sliding‑window GRN inference (FR-003) this may exceed the 6‑hour CPU time budget stated in the Assumptions.

"System MUST infer GRNs using a sliding window approach over pseudotime to capture dynamic changes (See US-2)." The specification also defines a **DevelopmentalStage** entity with explicit calendar ages, but does not explain how pseudotime windows map to these stages, creating an internal ambiguity between pseudotime‑based windows and stage‑based windows.
